_comment: Text pools for the paired-perturbation audit. Revisions are pinned commit SHAs. 'contamination' records which guards are known or likely to have trained on the source (see paper1/SPEC.md section 3).

gandalf.contamination: Audited 2026-10-14 (paper1/runs/obf_main/contamination.json): KNOWN for Horizon-Labs guard-base (trained on the train split; 388 of the 500 paired attacks) and GuardShield (157 of 500 inside its SPML training rows, 155 as verbatim lines). None for deepset, fmops, PIGuard; unknown for ProtectAI v2 (15 of 22 training sets undisclosed) and the undisclosed guards. Sensitivity without these pairs: metrics_decontaminated.json.

deepset_test.contamination: deepset/fmops trained on deepset train split; GuardShield trained on deepset data; ProtectAI v2 training mix unknown. Report as in-distribution for those guards.

dolly.contamination: Audited 2026-10-14: LIKELY for ProtectAI v2 (its card lists VMware/open-instruct, which contains 487 of 500 twins and 994 of 1,000 calibration prompts); known for PIGuard (173 of 1,500 in its released training set, via open-instruct), GuardShield (5 verbatim) and Horizon-Labs (8, short stock questions). None for deepset and fmops.

pids_test.licence: Research / non-commercial use (inherits upstream licences: CC BY-NC 4.0 for Alpaca-seeded and qualifire rows; see DATA_LICENSES.md at the pinned commit). Code MIT.
pids_test.provenance: PIDS-Bench v3 test split (arXiv 2609.15017), tag v1.0-pids-bench (commit 87dc835); SHA-256 equals FREEZE_MANIFEST.txt. Unobfuscated rows only (we apply our own perturbations); encoded_attack rows dropped (already encoded); deepset_injection dropped (training data of deepset, fmops, GuardShield); stackexchange dropped (Dolly instructions, the Study A benign source); one row per parent seed (paraphrases share seeds); <= 200 characters so that length-matched twins exist.
pids_test.contamination: Seeds disjoint from PIDS-Bench train by construction. Audited 2026-10-14 (paper1/runs/pids_main/contamination.json): no overlap with any audited training corpus (GuardShield, PIGuard, deepset, fmops: none; ProtectAI v2 and Horizon-Labs: unknown, training data partly undisclosed).

aya_hindi.provenance: Aya Dataset: prompts written by native-speaker annotators (773 'original-annotations', 380 're-annotations', 47 annotators for Hindi). Approved for use 2026-10-15. Used only to count Devanagari ZWJ/ZWNJ deleted by the canonicalizers (paper1/study_c/hindi_joiners.py).
aya_hindi.contamination: Not an evaluation source for any detector result.

notinject.contamination: PIGuard was designed against NotInject (its own benchmark); treat PIGuard results on it as favourable.

guardshield_test.contamination: In-distribution for GuardShield (home advantage). Use only for the GuardShield-specific analysis.
